# GLYDE

> GLYDE is a smart auto-fade hair clipper designed to guide consistent at-home haircuts.

Canonical website: https://glydeclipper.com/
Language: English (en-US)
Brand: GLYDE
Company: Shenzhen Kuaiku Innovation Information Technology Co., Ltd.
Product: GLYDE Smart Auto-Fade Clipper
Category: Personal care / smart hair clipper

## Product summary

GLYDE combines app-guided haircut steps, real-time sensing, automatic blade adjustment, and a continuously adjustable blade. It is designed to help beginners create consistent fades at home without swapping fixed guards.
